content.html: A catalyst is a substance that speeds up the rate of a chemical reaction and remains unchanged at the end of the reaction. Hydrogen peroxide solution, H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub>, breaks down to form oxygen. This decomposition is very slow if a catalyst is not used. Plan an investigation to show that copper(II) oxide is a suitable catalyst for this reaction. You can use aqueous hydrogen peroxide and common laboratory apparatus.
